description: Open Data Portal of Mongolia (opendata.gov.mn) is an open data portal listed in Open Data Portal of Mongolia (opendata.gov.mn), an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Mongolia (Cabinet Secretariat). The Unified Open Data Portal of Mongolia was launched in May 2020 by the Cabinet Secretariat under the World Bank financed Smart Government project, to publish data held by government bodies for reuse. Coverage: Mongolia. The portal answers from the cloud but is a JavaScript application whose catalogue interface could not be found from the outside, so its datasets were not listed; the number of datasets was not established. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-opendata-gov-mn-open-data-portal-of-mongolia.
